correctness.rationale: All-positive labeling forces support inside a spanning Hamiltonian cycle, hence a linear forest except full cycle; a forbidden endpoint labeling excludes spanning paths. For linear forests, contract every positive-edge path-run, retaining orientations. The remaining negative constraints form max-degree-two forbidden adjacencies; Dirac handles block counts >=6 and explicit 3..5-block cycles plus orientation handle the boundary. The precise two-component n-2 condition excludes orders 2 and 3. Labeled path-component exponential counting yields F_nk and M_n. An independent all-concept/all-compatible-support brute-force test at n=3..6 (8,37,218,1546 supports) matched every edge trace and formula; the unrestricted proof is separate.
